title: Score-level seed-ensemble: two independently seeded 3072-atom heads averaged at matched MACs
question: M126 closed the concatenation variant (flat accuracy, flat eff-rank). Does SCORE-LEVEL ensembling - two independently seeded (3072-atom dictionary, ridge head) pairs with per-row L2-normalised 345-score vectors averaged - beat Q(6144, 138000) = 0.22487 at matched total atoms (2 x 3072 = 6144)?

sparse.pool_seed_note: Both members draw from the SEALED 8192-candidate pool with different seeded permutations (11 = M117 exact; 22 = a fresh permutation of the same pool). Disclosed: same source pool, different subsets - the concatenation variant of this construction was measured at M126 (flat).

ensemble.rule: per-row L2 normalisation of each member's 345-score vector, then average; argmax. Registered BEFORE measurement.

gate.t1_reference: member 1 (seed 11) must reproduce M117 sealed Q(3072, 138000) = 0.2152753623188406
gate.kill_switch_ensemble: fired if ensemble_accuracy - 0.2248695652173913 < +0.005. Fired: the rank-8 ceiling is a property of the whitened patch space, not of the pool draw; the seed direction closes.
gate.eff_rank_report: effective rank of the joint 24576-width standardised Gram (participation ratio, M128 exact definition), reported alongside.
